# rotations-ops.library: Lerp

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Normalized linear interpolation along the shorter arc: the operands are
> taken with opposite signs when their dot product is negative, and the
> component-wise blend is renormalized. `amount` is unclamped.
> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slerp#Quaternion\_slerp

## Signature

```plato
Lerp(self: Quaternion, quaternion2: Quaternion, amount: Number): Quaternion
```

### Line 104

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/rotations-ops.library.plato, line 104](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/rotations-ops.library.plato#L104).

```plato

    //==
    // Interpolation

    // Normalized linear interpolation along the shorter arc: the operands are
    // taken with opposite signs when their dot product is negative, and the
    // component-wise blend is renormalized. `amount` is unclamped.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slerp#Quaternion_slerp
    Lerp(self: Quaternion, quaternion2: Quaternion, amount: Number): Quaternion {
        var t1 = 1.0 - amount;
        var blend = self.Dot(quaternion2) >= 0.0
            ? self * t1 + quaternion2 * amount
            : self * t1 - quaternion2 * amount;
        return blend.Normalize;
    }
```
